assets.source_citation: Lindqvist, G. (1989) 'A straightforward method for calculation of ice resistance of ships', POAC'89, Lulea, Vol. 2, pp. 722-735 -- crushing-list coefficient C_c = 0.5[tan(90-phi/2) + mu/cos(90-phi/2)]

tolerance.note: closed-form evaluation of the cited expression; tolerance covers only rounding of the stored number

assets.verification_note: Expression re-derived symbolically and dimension-checked (dimensionless); the primary POAC'89 paper could not be opened in the build environment, so the coefficient form is taken from the repository transcription (ice_anchor/anchors.py::lindqvist_1989) and from the standard quotation of Lindqvist's method in the ice-resistance literature.

assets.source_citation: Lindqvist, G. (1989) POAC'89, Vol. 2, pp. 722-735 -- speed coefficient C_s = 0.15 + 0.3*Fr_h with Froude number Fr_h = V/sqrt(g h)

tolerance.note: arithmetic evaluation at the documented reference condition

assets.verification_note: Dimensionless by construction (V/sqrt(g h)); coefficient pair (0.15, 0.3) taken from the repository transcription of Lindqvist (1989), primary paper not accessible for direct transcription.

assets.source_citation: Lindqvist (1989) POAC'89 pp. 722-735 and ISO 19906 (2010) Annex A friction guidance -- ice/steel kinetic friction coefficient in the 0.05-0.20 band, 0.15 used as the design mid-value

tolerance.note: band width of the published ice/steel friction scatter

assets.verification_note: Band transcribed from the engineering consensus for ice-on-steel friction (0.05-0.20, temperature and sliding-speed dependent); the exact table of the cited standards was not accessible, only the band as quoted in the literature.

assets.formula: R_c = C_c*s_c*h^2 ; R_f = C_f*rho*g*h ; R_s = C_s*rho*V^2*h*B
known_defects: R_c omits the ship-breadth factor (force scales as sigma_c*h^2 only)
R_f is C_f*rho*g*h with C_f containing B, so R_f is dimensionally a force per unit breadth times B/h-dependent factor -- breadth handling differs from R_s
assets.source_citation: Lindqvist, G. (1989) POAC'89, Vol. 2, pp. 722-735 (components R_c, R_f, R_s) as transcribed in TensorPhysics ice_anchor/anchors.py::lindqvist_1989

tolerance.note: regression drift budget for the repository transcription; NOT an accuracy claim against ice-tank data

assets.verification_note: Frozen value of this repository's documented transcription; the crushing and buoyancy terms as transcribed carry no explicit breadth factor in R_c and a breadth-bearing coefficient C_f in R_f, i.e. the component set is not dimensionally homogeneous across breadth. Recorded as a regression anchor only: do not quote R_total_kN as validated absolute resistance. See docs/ICE_NAV_REFS_CORPUS.md, section 'Known defects caught by this corpus'.
